documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consider And Approve The Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported a strong start to financial year '27 with healthy revenue growth and significantly improved profitability driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement. Management highlighted the successful commercial operation of solar power projects expected to reduce annual power costs, while the 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion in Odisha is progressing with the first phase of production expected in the third quarter. The company remains optimistic about medium to long-term demand, supported by normalized inventories, favorable trade agreements, and improved global sourcing patterns favoring India. Sportking India reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching Rs. 703.7 crores and EBITDA at Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects the current quarter to be similar or even better than the previous quarter.
guidance.quote: But yes, the current quarter looks to be similar or even better than what we have delivered this last quarter.

guidance.claim: The company targets to reach 96% to 97% capacity utilization for the new Odisha plant by the start of the next financial year.
guidance.quote: Of course, that's our target that we want to reach 96%, 97% utilization by the start of the next financial year.

guidance.claim: Management expects top line revenue to reach around INR3,000 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Top line revenue is projected to increase to more than INR4,000 crores next year with the new plant.
guidance.quote: And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: The company gives a long-term EBITDA margin guidance of around 15% once the new project comes in.
guidance.quote: So we give a long-term guidance of once a new project comes in a guidance of 15%, and we'll stick to that.

guidance.claim: Management expects top line to increase by 7% to 10% in the next three quarters due to higher prices.
guidance.quote: So we expect top line to increase by 7% to 10% in the next three quarters because of the higher prices.

guidance.claim: The company expects margins to expand quarter-on-quarter by at least 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: We don't -- they'll be -- they shall be -- we are looking at quarter-on-quarter expanding by at least 15%, 20%.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates the newly acquired companies to grow by 15% to 20% at least in FY27.
guidance.quote: FY27 now, we expect both the companies to grow by 15% to 20% at least.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets continued to remain healthy, with supportive domestic demand expected from the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter. On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: Global cotton yarn demand has improved, supported by supply chain realignment, healthy export demand, and increased sourcing diversification.
demand_outlook.quote: Another encouraging trend has been the improvement in global cotton yarn demand. Supply chain realignment, healthy export demand and increased sourcing diversification by international customers, which has supported the yarn realizations and profitability.

demand_outlook.claim: Most of the incremental demand for yarn export into India has come from China due to subdued Chinese markets and higher Chinese cotton prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China. Bangladesh continues to be steady as they were. And China, we continue to see every month, we see them as a buyer. And we think that this is going to go on because there the cotton crop is also getting a little smaller.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted improved demand in almost all geographies and segments they serve.
demand_outlook.quote: First of all, the improved demand in almost all the geographies across the world and in all the segments that we meet.

demand_outlook.claim: China has emerged as a large importer of cotton yarn with its share increasing to almost 25% to 30%.
demand_outlook.quote: The resurgence of China as a large importer of cotton yarn, the share increased from 7% to 8% to almost 25% to 30%, and they keep on buying.

demand_outlook.claim: Local demand has been leading the charge since March after U.S. tariffs went away.
demand_outlook.quote: Local demand though lagging for first few months is now leading the charge since March when the U.S. tariff went away.

demand_outlook.claim: Cotton spreads have reached nearly three-year highs and are expanding.
demand_outlook.quote: Cotton spreads have reached almost 3- year highs and are expanding.

demand_outlook.claim: Bangladesh continues to be the company's number one market in export.
demand_outlook.quote: Bangladesh continues to be our number 1 market in export.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing continuous demand for almost all kinds of yarns for the last 3 months.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now for last 3 months, 4 months -- 3 months we are seeing a continuous demand for almost all kinds of yarns.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned with construction underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total announced capex for the Odisha project is about INR1,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ma'am, right now, what we have announced is about INR1000 crores, INR975 crores and which will be completed by the end of this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The 40-megawatt solar power supply will commence by the end of May and save approximately INR14 crores to INR15 crores annually.
capex_expansion.quote: The 40-megawatt solar power supply will commence by the end of May and is expected to save around INR14 crores to INR15 crores next year, this -- annually.

capex_expansion.claim: A greenfield expansion project of approximately INR1,000 crores is underway to enhance spindle capacity by around 150,000 spindles.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also making strong progress on our greenfield expansion project of approximately INR1,000 crores, which will enhance our spindle capacity by around 150,000 spindles.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial operations of the greenfield project are expected to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect the commercial operations of the project to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our strategic growth plan, the Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, which will strengthen our processing capabilities and enhance our integrated operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has also approved the acquisition of the manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis subject to definitive agreement and customary approvals.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic buying approach enabled the company to effectively manage input costs and protect margins despite raw material price increases.
margins_costs.quote: Despite some increases in raw material prices during this period, our strategic buying approach enabled us to effectively manage input costs and protect margins.

margins_costs.claim: The recently commenced solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: Annual cost savings from the solar project are expected to be around INR15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant is expected to generate margins 300 to 400 basis points higher than older plants due to embedded incentives.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

margins_costs.claim: Overall product spread for the quarter was INR133 compared to INR107 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The SPV commissioned a Solar Power Plant with a capacity of 40.3 MW which is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved during the quarter supported by better yarn realization and cotton yarn demand.
margins_costs.quote: Our revenue broadly remained stable while profitability improved. This growth was supported by better yarn realization and better demand for cotton yarn during the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Rupee depreciation is helping make Indian spinning more competitive.
margins_costs.quote: The rupee depreciation is helping to make Indian spinning more competitive.

margins_costs.claim: Cotton yarn spread between skein cost and final yarn prices is currently around more than $1.
margins_costs.quote: Cotton yarn spread today is, I think, around more than $1 between the skein cost and the final yarn prices.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days as part of its policy to manage inventory risks.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilisation of all units is more than 96%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilisation of all units more than 96%

orders_capacity.claim: The company is already operating at optimum capacity levels of 95%, 96%.
orders_capacity.quote: Volume-wise, we don't see any increase in volume because we are already working at full capacity, whatever is optimum capacity, 95%, 96%.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

risks_headwinds.claim: The macro climate carries huge uncertainty due to multiple ongoing wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though there are some headwinds as well, the macro climate is still of huge uncertainty because of multiple wars going on.

risks_headwinds.claim: Inflation forecasts indicate higher inflation which generally does not bode well for growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Inflation forecasts are of higher inflation, which generally doesn't bode well for growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Duty on cotton continues to be a detriment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Duty on cotton, though right now not that relevant, continues to be a detriment.

management_commitments.claim: The first phase of production at the Odisha greenfield expansion is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: It will take around 5 to 6 months to fully ramp up the Odisha plant, reaching about 90% capacity utilization by March end.
management_commitments.quote: So it will take us around 5 to 6 months to fully ramp up. And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: The proportion of value-added products from the garment and fabric division is targeted to reach around 10% in the next one year.
management_commitments.quote: But in next 1 year, we would say around 10%.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial operations of the greenfield project are expected to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the commercial operations of the project to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Both the EU and UK FTAs are expected to be effective from within this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So we expect both the FTAs to be effective from within this -- by the end of this financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
